title: Component Compatibility Matrix
description: Build a comprehensive compatibility test matrix using templates, variables, and custom keywords.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "We need to verify 20 ship components are compatible with different firmware versions. That's 60 test combinations. Use templates, variables, and custom validation logic to test the entire matrix efficiently."
story.context: Real-world testing often involves matrices: N components × M configurations = lots of tests. Templates make this manageable. This challenge tests your ability to structure complex data-driven test suites.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Outstanding! You tested 20 components across 3 firmware versions—60 compatibility checks with one template. You've mastered data-driven testing. This is how we scale quality assurance."

theory.title: Challenge 2.3: Component Compatibility Matrix
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "This is production-scale data-driven testing, PROTO-7. Testing component compatibility matrices is real-world QA. We could write 60 separate test cases, or we could use templates intelligently and write it once. Which sounds better?"

Data-Driven Testing at Scale

Real automation often involves testing matrices:

  • Compatibility testing: Components × Firmware versions
  • API testing: Endpoints × HTTP methods × Auth types
  • Browser testing: Features × Browsers × OS combinations
  • Data validation: Fields × Data types × Constraints

Templates make this manageable:

  1. Define validation logic ONCE (custom keyword)
  2. Create variables for test subjects (lists)
  3. Use templates to execute matrix efficiently
  4. Scale to hundreds of tests with minimal code

⚠️ Challenge Architecture

  • Variables: Store components, firmware versions, thresholds
  • Custom Keyword: Complex validation logic (compatibility check)
  • Templates: Execute keyword with matrix data
  • Test Organization: One test per component, data rows for versions
  • Summary Test: Uses [Template] NONE for reporting
  • This pattern scales: add more components or firmware = just more data rows
  • Maintainable: Change MIN_COMPATIBILITY_SCORE once, updates all tests

Real-World Application

This challenge demonstrates patterns used in:

  • Cross-browser testing (Selenium/Playwright)
  • API contract testing (multiple endpoints)
  • Database migration validation (schema × data)
  • Regression test suites (features × environments)

You've learned to structure complex test matrices efficiently—a critical skill for scalable test automation.
